scope: IAB browser checks on the production App and Workbench, using the isolated M8 qualification database on localhost:5318. Physical gamepad hardware and subjective audio quality were not assessed.

physicalLap.scope: Production App, Workbench, 120 Hz four-wheel physics, conservative scripted VehicleControls, real gates and limits, isolated qualification IndexedDB.

checks.name: Real 120 Hz physical lap through production timing gates and HUD
Three sector times sum to the valid finish and personal best
Compatible pose ghost validates and persists in IndexedDB
Personal best and ghost restore after page reload
Imported compatible ghost preserves the earned personal best
FF change hides the FR best; FR restores its own best
FR ghost import is rejected for FF with an explicit compatibility message
Opening a modal invalidates an active timed lap
Vehicle reset persists an invalid recent lap immediately
Quality and ghost display controls preserve compatible saved records
Bonnet view renders; chase/top/orbit controls remain available
Driving sound starts through the UI and can be silenced
Import and drive an existing accepted 24 km M7 circuit
Library naming, favourite filter and search operate
Library removal is recoverable through Trash and Restore
Library entries and favourite persist after reload
Saving an existing active accepted route deduplicates the entry
Loading the library route retains the FR vehicle
Session and library export controls complete without an error

notes: The final browser lap matched the existing 61.198 s best, so its already validated ghost was retained rather than replaced. The original browser-created ghost has 1,225 poses / 117,600 bytes.
Library and record QA data use an isolated diagnostic store. Normal-user personal bests and circuit entries were not populated by the scripted controller.
Byte/checksum round trips and malformed-data cases are additionally covered by Node tests and the 25-lap campaign.
The final library restore was repeated after removing its unrelated legacy-workshop-save side effect; it loaded the accepted 24 km definition and retained the FR car.
